appointment_google_etag_requires_event.name: appointment_google_etag_requires_event
appointment_google_etag_requires_event.value: "appointment"."google_etag" is null or "appointment"."google_event_id" is not null

contact_kind_fields.name: contact_kind_fields
contact_kind_fields.value:
(
        "contact"."kind" = 'person'
          and "contact"."last_name" is not null
          and "contact"."company_name" is null and "contact"."contact_person" is null
      ) or (
        "contact"."kind" = 'organization'
          and "contact"."company_name" is not null
          and "contact"."salutation" is null and "contact"."title" is null
          and "contact"."first_name" is null and "contact"."last_name" is null
          and "contact"."date_of_birth" is null
          and "contact"."birth_place" is null and "contact"."gender" is null
      )

invoice_draft_fields.name: invoice_draft_fields
invoice_draft_fields.value:
("invoice"."status" = 'draft'
             and "invoice"."number" is null and "invoice"."number_value" is null
             and "invoice"."number_prefix" is null and "invoice"."pdf_path" is null
             and "invoice"."pdf_hash" is null and "invoice"."finalized_at" is null)
          or ("invoice"."status" <> 'draft'
             and "invoice"."number" is not null and "invoice"."number_value" is not null
             and "invoice"."number_prefix" is not null and "invoice"."pdf_path" is not null
             and "invoice"."pdf_hash" is not null and "invoice"."finalized_at" is not null
             and "invoice"."recipient_snapshot" is not null)

invoice_cancelled_state.name: invoice_cancelled_state
invoice_cancelled_state.value:
("invoice"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("invoice"."cancelled_by_invoice_id" is not null)
          and ("invoice"."cancelled_by_invoice_id" is null or "invoice"."type" = 'invoice')

invoice_cancellation_not_self.name: invoice_cancellation_not_self
invoice_cancellation_not_self.value:
"invoice"."cancels_invoice_id" is distinct from "invoice"."id"
          and "invoice"."cancelled_by_invoice_id" is distinct from "invoice"."id"

note_chain_head_key.name: note_chain_head_key
note_chain_head_key.where: "note"."locked_at" is not null and "note"."prev_hash" is null

note_lock_fields.name: note_lock_fields
note_lock_fields.value:
("note"."locked_at" is null and "note"."locked_by" is null and "note"."content_hash" is null)
          or ("note"."locked_at" is not null and "note"."locked_by" is not null and "note"."content_hash" is not null)

note_prev_hash_requires_lock.name: note_prev_hash_requires_lock
note_prev_hash_requires_lock.value: "note"."prev_hash" is null or "note"."locked_at" is not null

note_hash_shape.name: note_hash_shape
note_hash_shape.value:
("note"."content_hash" is null or "note"."content_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
          and ("note"."prev_hash" is null or "note"."prev_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

smtp_settings_password_needs_user.name: smtp_settings_password_needs_user
smtp_settings_password_needs_user.value: "smtp_settings"."password_cipher" is null or "smtp_settings"."username" is not null
